metadata.title: Cosmological Evolution: From Black Hole Bounce to Modern Humans

epochs.name: Kerr Black Hole Interior & Torsion Bounce
epochs.description: The universe originates not from an infinite mathematical singularity, but from an Einstein-Cartan spin-torsion bounce inside a parent rotating Kerr black hole. Relic frame-dragging vorticity establishes the cosmic spin axis.

epochs.name: Cosmic Dawn & Recombination
epochs.description: Protons and electrons combine to form neutral hydrogen, releasing the Cosmic Microwave Background. Neutral fog envelops the cosmos until the first Pop III stars ignite the cosmic dawn.

epochs.name: MoM-z14: Mother of Miracles
epochs.description: JWST discovery of MoM-z14: An ultra-compact (re = 74 pc), fiercely luminous (M_UV = -20.2) galaxy enriched in nitrogen. Seeded by accelerated torsion fluctuations, defying standard gradual Lambda-CDM assembly.

epochs.name: JADES Era & Galaxy Spin Alignment
epochs.description: Spiral galaxies condense along cosmic filaments. Frame-dragging vorticity from the parent Kerr black hole biases tidal torques, creating a 60:40 clockwise spin asymmetry (158 CW vs 105 CCW).

epochs.name: XLSSC 122: Strong Gravitational Lensing
epochs.description: XLSSC 122: The most distant strong-lensing galaxy cluster known. Its hyper-concentrated dark matter core (c_200 = 6.3) creates giant blue arcs and mature intracluster light, confirming accelerated early structure growth.

epochs.name: Modern Universe, Solar System & Humanity
epochs.description: The cosmic web expands towards the Hubble horizon (R_H = R_s). In an unassuming spiral arm of the Milky Way, the Solar System and Earth harbor intelligent life capable of deciphering their own black hole origin.
